status: Retrospective readout audit of previously inspected public measurements; prospective C/E experiment design has no acquired outcomes.
empirical_rule: Retain all origin measurements in the two authenticated one-dimensional characteristic datasets. Separately retain every nominal opposite-coordinate pair in the 40-row position scan. No new fitted parameter or response correction.
pair_prediction: Imag chi(+ih)+Imag chi(-ih)=0 for the same state and opposite physical probe coordinates. Printed coordinate asymmetries are reported; their interpretation as roundoff is a separate premise.
published_count_use: No inferred counts, standard errors or empirical significance. Public files contain aggregate values, not authenticated accepted trials.

prospective.readout: Both native signed-current heralds, compiled balanced preparation/analyzer, native coin-current pointer; retain failure and impossible outcomes.
prospective.decision: Fixed-trial likelihood-ratio threshold one on the complete six-outcome law; ties select C.
prospective.sampling_premise: Independent fresh identical trials of one locked ideal candidate and its specified apparatus. No optional stopping or fitted preparation.
